description: Distinguish 'SECURE FIRST MOORINGS' (joined == 0) from 'CONNECT AND TEST SEAM' in apps/openagents-web/slab.coax, metaverse/slab-construction.coax, and index.md.

steps.send: In the SLAB construction visualization (`apps/openagents-web/slab.coax`, `metaverse/slab-construction.coax`, and `apps/openagents-web/realms/slab/index.md`): 1) In `build_hud` (`apps/openagents-web/slab.coax`), when `b.phase == BUILD_JOIN && b.approach >= 0.65`, display `"SECURE FIRST MOORINGS"` if `b.joined == 0`, else `"CONNECT AND TEST SEAM"`. 2) Update `BTN_FIRST_JOIN` in `press` to seek to `build_cursor(BUILD_SAIL + BUILD_CYCLE + 0.92)` so it lands on the first real seam (`joining.joined == 1 && joining.phase == BUILD_JOIN && joining.approach > 0.65`) and add an assertion for it in the build `#test`. 3) Update `metaverse/slab-construction.coax` and `apps/openagents-web/realms/slab/index.md` accordingly. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-web/slab.coax --only build`.

graders.run: grep -q 'SECURE FIRST MOORINGS' apps/openagents-web/slab.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-web/slab.coax --only build
